# The libraries the macOS driver may load: the path every LC_LOAD_DYLIB names, in either slice, must
# be listed here (the other library load forms fail as forms the tool does not read). All are part
# of macOS. One path per line.
/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/Versions/A/CoreFoundation
/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Versions/A/CoreServices
/System/Library/Frameworks/Kerberos.framework/Versions/A/Kerberos
/System/Library/Frameworks/Network.framework/Versions/A/Network
/System/Library/Frameworks/Security.framework/Versions/A/Security
/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib
/usr/lib/libc++.1.dylib
/usr/lib/libresolv.9.dylib
